summary: Gone tower listed on a sandy summit in Potomac State Forest, Garrett County. No build date, staffing or tower remains are described.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. No tower remains are described at the summit.

access.note: Reached on foot in Potomac State Forest; the state forest map labels Eagle Rock beside Backbone Mtn and Lostland.

visit.trail_note: About a quarter mile on foot from the end of Eagle Rock Road; the boulders are steep and sandy.

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence. Only the Forest Fire Lookout Association list entry supports the tower; it gives no build date, design, height, staffing or fate. Lead not used: a 1942 Oakland (Md.) Republican reprint of a Baltimore Sun column (loc.gov sn88065202, 1942-08-27, p. 10) gives Eagle Rock's surveyed elevation as 3,162 ft and refers to a fire tower at Roth Rock; its page text could not be read from the cache. Other loc.gov Republican hits for 'eagle rock' plus 'fire tower' (1953, 1955, 1959, 1961) are unread and may hold the tower's history. The state's COMAR list omits Eagle Rock, so ownership is unknown. Story runs about 170 words, above the thin-evidence target.
